QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Speaking Hall Preparation 3 (Stew)
QuestInfo.0: Stew, the Democratic donkey, needs your help.
QuestInfo.1: Stew needs Printer Paper, but none of it was unloaded from the boxes. Break boxes to get the paper!
QuestInfo.2: Return to Stew with your 50 stacks of Printer Paper.

0.0: This isn't gonna work. We're all outta paper and I have got a whooole lot of fliers to put up. I've been stealing Cole's undies as a sort of stop-gap, but I'm running out of fabric. There are boxes of the stuff in the Speaking Hall, if you can brave it.

yes.0: I'm going to make the best fliers that anybody has ever made.

no.0: Oh, come on! Do it for me, your little donkey friend?

yes.0: These fliers are really going to shove it in their red faces. It'll be way better than the ones I printed on Cole's old undies. I just know it!

stop.0: It's not that hard! It's just picking up papers!
